title.zh: Igloo旗下Abstract二层网络宣布将于2026年12月15日关闭并转向Pudgy Penguins
title.en: Igloo's Abstract L2 to shut down on Dec. 15, 2026 and pivot to Pudgy Penguins

current_state.zh: Igloo Inc. 正逐步关停 Abstract 链并转向 Pudgy Penguins/PENGU；Abstract L2 已确定 12 月 15 日关停，但各资产迁移通道的截止日期可能更早，用户须尽快操作，否则资金将无法访问；公司放弃通过代币发行救助该链。
current_state.en: Igloo Inc. is winding down the Abstract chain and pivoting to Pudgy Penguins/PENGU; Abstract’s Ethereum L2 is set to shut down on Dec. 15, but asset-migration channels may have earlier deadlines, so users must act promptly or funds become inaccessible; the company has forgone a token launch to save the chain.

updates.title_zh: Abstract 将于 12 月 15 日关闭其以太坊 Layer 2 网络
updates.title_en: Abstract to Shut Down on Dec. 15; Igloo Says It Lost Tens of Millions Over Two Y
updates.what_changed_zh:
Pudgy Penguins 母公司 Igloo Inc. 打造的以太坊 Layer 2 网络 Abstract 宣布将于 12 月 15 日关闭，用户必须在此前通过 Abstract 的 Migration Hub 或原生跨链桥将资产转出。Igloo 表示，过去两年维持该链运营已亏损数千万美元，此后将把资源重新聚焦于 Pudgy Penguins、Pudgy NFT 与 PENGU。

未在截止日期前跨链转出的资金将无法取回，Abstract 的工程师将协助在其网络上构建的项目迁移至其他链。这是数日内第二个宣布关停的以太坊 Layer 2，前一个是 Paradigm 支持的 Blast。

Abstract 是一条 ZK-rollup，其原生跨链桥存在三小时延迟。据团队自己的统计，该链处理了超过 3.25 亿笔交易，去中心化交易所交易量超过 60 亿美元，生态收入超过 4000 万美元，创建了逾 400 万个 Abstract Global Wallet，Red Bull Racing 和迪士尼等品牌曾使用该链。团队还提醒用户警惕冒充者、虚假迁移网站以及自称代表该项目的私信。
updates.what_changed_en: Abstract, the consumer L2 backed by Pudgy Penguins parent Igloo, will shut down on December 15, 2026 after Igloo lost tens of millions of dollars over two years, with remaining resources redirected to Pudgy Penguins, Pudgy NFTs and PENGU.

updates.detailed_summary_en: Abstract, the consumer L2 backed by Pudgy Penguins parent Igloo, will shut down on December 15, 2026 after Igloo lost tens of millions of dollars over two years, with remaining resources redirected to Pudgy Penguins, Pudgy NFTs and PENGU.
updates.background_zh: Abstract 是一条 ZK-rollup，即通过零知识证明把交易打包并在以太坊上验证的 Layer 2 网络，Igloo 将其定位为面向普通用户的“消费者加密”应用之家。2024 年 7 月，Igloo 在 Founders Fund 领投的一轮融资中筹集了超过 1100 万美元，用于成立 Cube Labs 并支持 Abstract 的开发。团队将关停归因于 DeFi 生态有限、链上流动性稀薄、与机构交集较少以及预算少于竞争对手，并写道“专注于消费者加密的链作为独立模式最终被证明是不可持续的”。
updates.background_en: Abstract is a ZK-rollup, a layer-2 network that bundles transactions and verifies them on Ethereum using zero-knowledge proofs, and Igloo pitched it as a home for "consumer crypto" apps aimed at everyday users. In July 2024, Igloo raised over $11 million in a Founders Fund-led round to establish Cube Labs and support Abstract's development. The team attributed the shutdown to a limited DeFi ecosystem, thin on-chain liquidity, little crossover with institutions and a smaller budget than rivals, writing that "operating a chain focused exclusively on consumer crypto has ultimately proven to be unsustainable as a standalone model."
updates.market_impact_zh: Abstract 的关停会通过 Migration Hub 和原生跨链桥把用户资金与应用流动性导向其他链，而 Igloo 明确表示将重新聚焦 Pudgy Penguins 与 PENGU，使该事件直接关联到该代币及相关 NFT 系列的持有者。与 Blast 的关停一起，这也延续了近期以太坊 Layer 2 收缩的趋势。
updates.market_impact_en: Abstract's shutdown directs user funds and app liquidity toward other chains through its Migration Hub and native bridge, while Igloo's stated refocus on Pudgy Penguins and PENGU links the event directly to holders of that token and the related NFT collections. It also adds to the recent pattern of Ethereum layer-2 consolidation, alongside Blast's wind-down.

updates.title_zh: Pudgy Penguins旗下的Abstract成为一周内第二个关停的以太坊二层网络
updates.title_en: Pudgy Penguins’ Abstract becomes second Ethereum layer 2 to shut in a week
updates.what_changed_zh: 新报道补充了关键量化事实：截至周三，Abstract 网络上仍有约 7600 万美元用户资产需要在关停前转移，否则将无法取回；同时披露链上费用约 3,900 美元/24 小时，而生态应用收入约 39,000 美元，并指出 Abstract 于 2025 年 1 月上线、Igloo 已资助约 18 个月，团队明确拒绝发币或 ICO 融资。
updates.what_changed_en: The report adds key quantified facts: about $76 million in user assets remained on Abstract as of Wednesday and must be moved before the Dec. 15 shutdown or become inaccessible; it also reports roughly $3,900 in 24-hour chain fees versus about $39,000 in application revenue, notes Abstract launched in January 2025 and was funded by Igloo for about 18 months, and says the team explicitly rejected launching a token or ICO.
updates.current_state_zh: Abstract 将于 12 月 15 日关停，约 7600 万美元用户资产仍待转出；Igloo 累计亏损数千万美元并拒绝发币融资，将资源聚焦 Pudgy Penguins、Pudgy NFTs 与 PENGU。
updates.current_state_en: Abstract will shut down on Dec. 15 with about $76 million in user assets still to be moved; Igloo, having lost tens of millions of dollars and declining to launch a token, will refocus resources on Pudgy Penguins, Pudgy NFTs and PENGU.
updates.detailed_summary_zh: Igloo is shutting down its Pudgy Penguins-linked Abstract Ethereum layer-2 on Dec. 15 after losing tens of millions of dollars, leaving about $76 million in user assets that must be moved before the network goes offline, making it the second L2 to close within a week after Blast.
updates.detailed_summary_en: Igloo is shutting down its Pudgy Penguins-linked Abstract Ethereum layer-2 on Dec. 15 after losing tens of millions of dollars, leaving about $76 million in user assets that must be moved before the network goes offline, making it the second L2 to close within a week after Blast.

updates.title_en: ⚡️Abstract关停公告后，某新建地址集中买入25枚胖企鹅NFT
updates.what_changed_zh: Igloo Inc. 正在逐步关闭其 Abstract 链，全面转向 Pudgy Penguins、Pudgy NFT 和 PENGU。公告发布后不久，一个新地址从 Kraken 转出 100 万美元，抢购了 25 个 Pudgy Penguin NFT。
updates.what_changed_en: Igloo Inc. is winding down its Abstract chain and pivoting entirely to Pudgy Penguins, Pudgy NFTs and PENGU, with a new address moving $1M off Kraken to snap up 25 Pudgy Penguin NFTs shortly after the announcement.
updates.current_state_zh: Igloo Inc. 正在逐步关闭其 Abstract 链，全面转向 Pudgy Penguins、Pudgy NFT 和 PENGU。公告发布后不久，一个新地址从 Kraken 转出 100 万美元，抢购了 25 个 Pudgy Penguin NFT。
updates.current_state_en: Igloo Inc. is winding down its Abstract chain and pivoting entirely to Pudgy Penguins, Pudgy NFTs and PENGU, with a new address moving $1M off Kraken to snap up 25 Pudgy Penguin NFTs shortly after the announcement.
updates.detailed_summary_zh: Igloo Inc. is winding down its Abstract chain and pivoting entirely to Pudgy Penguins, Pudgy NFTs and PENGU, with a new address moving $1M off Kraken to snap up 25 Pudgy Penguin NFTs shortly after the announcement.
updates.detailed_summary_en: Igloo Inc. is winding down its Abstract chain and pivoting entirely to Pudgy Penguins, Pudgy NFTs and PENGU, with a new address moving $1M off Kraken to snap up 25 Pudgy Penguin NFTs shortly after the announcement.
updates.background_zh: Abstract 是由 Pudgy Penguins 母公司 Igloo Inc. 开发的 Layer 2 区块链，基于 zkSync 的 ZK 技术栈并采用 EigenDA，定位为面向消费级应用的网络。Pudgy Penguins 是一个包含 8888 枚 NFT 的系列，其团队还于2024年12月推出了 PENGU 代币。
updates.background_en: Abstract is a Layer 2 blockchain developed by Igloo Inc., the parent company of Pudgy Penguins, and is built on zkSync's ZK stack with EigenDA, targeting consumer-facing web3 applications. Pudgy Penguins is an 8,888-piece NFT collection whose team also issues the PENGU token, launched in December 2024.
updates.market_impact_zh: 此次公告使 Igloo/Pudgy 体系从自营消费级公链转向 Pudgy Penguins 品牌、NFT 与 PENGU 代币，这一资源重配直接关系到上述资产的持有者以及 NFT 市场上的交易者。目前可观察到的市场反应主要限于 NFT 端：单个新地址带来100万美元资金流入，地板价24小时内上涨6.8%至3.3 ETH；至于对 PENGU 代币、Abstract 自身用户与流动性的影响，现有证据尚不足以确认。
updates.market_impact_en: The announcement shifts the Igloo/Pudgy complex away from running its own consumer chain and toward the Pudgy Penguins brand, NFTs and PENGU token, a reallocation that touches holders of those assets and traders on NFT marketplaces. The observed market reaction is limited so far to the NFT side — a $1 million inflow from a single new address and a 6.8% 24-hour floor move to 3.3 ETH — while any effect on the PENGU token or on Abstract's own users and liquidity is not established by the available evidence.

updates.title_zh: 为什么 Abstract 选择关停其以太坊 L2，而不是发行代币来挽救它
updates.title_en: Why Abstract is killing its Ethereum L2 instead of launching a token to save it
updates.what_changed_zh: Abstract 已确定将于 12月15日关停其以太坊 L2，并要求用户在截止前跨链转出资产；Igloo CEO 称已损失数千万美元，并放弃通过发行代币来救助该链。
updates.what_changed_en: Abstract has set Dec. 15 as the shutdown date for its Ethereum L2, warned users to bridge assets off the chain before then, and Igloo’s CEO said the company lost tens of millions of dollars while forgoing a token launch as a lifeline.
updates.current_state_zh: Igloo Inc. 正逐步关停 Abstract 链并转向 Pudgy Penguins/PENGU；Abstract L2 已确定 12月15日关停，用户须在该期限前桥出资产，否则资金将无法访问；公司放弃通过代币发行救助该链。
updates.current_state_en: Igloo Inc. is winding down the Abstract chain and pivoting to Pudgy Penguins/PENGU; Abstract’s Ethereum L2 is now set to shut down on Dec. 15, users must bridge assets off before the deadline or funds become inaccessible, and the company has forgone a token launch to save the chain.
updates.detailed_summary_zh: Abstract will shut down its Ethereum L2 on Dec. 15 after losing tens of millions of dollars, citing stagnant growth and thin liquidity, and warns users to bridge assets off the chain before funds become inaccessible.
updates.detailed_summary_en: Abstract will shut down its Ethereum L2 on Dec. 15 after losing tens of millions of dollars, citing stagnant growth and thin liquidity, and warns users to bridge assets off the chain before funds become inaccessible.

updates.title_zh: Abstract 的关停暴露了拥有资产与能够转移资产之间的差距
updates.title_en: Abstract’s shutdown exposes the gap between owning assets and being able to move them
updates.what_changed_zh: 后续报道补充了 Abstract 关闭的具体日期为 2026 年 12 月 15 日，并说明各迁移路径的启动、完成和申领截止时间可能更早；Cube 条款还明确了迁移与资产访问的相关条件。
updates.what_changed_en: Follow-up coverage adds that Abstract's shutdown date is Dec. 15, 2026, with route-specific initiation, completion, and claim cutoffs potentially earlier; Cube terms also clarify migration and asset-access conditions.
updates.current_state_zh: 每日加密简报中的 Abstract 分阶段关闭事件现已明确：Abstract 将于 2026 年 12 月 15 日关闭，各迁移路径的截止时间可能更早；Coinbase 计划年底前重启 Coinbase Pro 仍按此前报道。
updates.current_state_en: The Abstract phased shutdown covered in the daily crypto briefing is now more specific: Abstract will shut down on Dec. 15, 2026, with route-specific migration cutoffs potentially earlier; Coinbase's planned Coinbase Pro relaunch by year-end remains as previously reported.
updates.detailed_summary_zh: Ethereum layer-2 network Abstract will shut down on Dec. 15, 2026, forcing users to migrate assets before route-specific cutoffs or lose practical access to funds even though they technically retain ownership.
updates.detailed_summary_en: Ethereum layer-2 network Abstract will shut down on Dec. 15, 2026, forcing users to migrate assets before route-specific cutoffs or lose practical access to funds even though they technically retain ownership.

updates.title_en: FN 速递丨Abstract 关停警示：拥有资产不等于能转出
updates.what_changed_zh: 新报道警示：Abstract 的 12 月 15 日关停伴随各资产迁移通道的提前截止日期，用户需在更早时间发起操作、完成交易和申领权益，仅持有资产不等于能及时转出。
updates.what_changed_en: The report warns that Abstract’s December 15 shutdown comes with earlier deadlines across asset-migration channels, requiring users to initiate operations, complete transactions and claim rights sooner, and that merely holding assets does not guarantee timely withdrawal.
updates.current_state_zh: Igloo Inc. 正逐步关停 Abstract 链并转向 Pudgy Penguins/PENGU；Abstract L2 已确定 12 月 15 日关停，但各资产迁移通道的截止日期可能更早，用户须尽快操作，否则资金将无法访问；公司放弃通过代币发行救助该链。
updates.current_state_en: Igloo Inc. is winding down the Abstract chain and pivoting to Pudgy Penguins/PENGU; Abstract’s Ethereum L2 is set to shut down on Dec. 15, but asset-migration channels may have earlier deadlines, so users must act promptly or funds become inaccessible; the company has forgone a token launch to save the chain.
updates.detailed_summary_zh: Abstract's December 15 shutdown comes with earlier deadlines across its asset-migration channels, warning users that merely holding assets on the chain does not guarantee they can be withdrawn in time.
updates.detailed_summary_en: Abstract's December 15 shutdown comes with earlier deadlines across its asset-migration channels, warning users that merely holding assets on the chain does not guarantee they can be withdrawn in time.
